stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G005】词形变化、词缀构词与词性语法槽位匹配（名、动、形、副）；【G010】不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP009】谨慎归因与多因素解释（May Account For / Be Attributable To），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 词形变化、词缀构词与词性语法槽位匹配（名、动、形、副）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握学术词族与常见词缀（-able, -cy, -ify, -ise/-ize, -ism/-ist, -less, anti-, co-, il-/im-/in-/ir-, multi-, over-, pre-, post-）的转换，确保名词充当主宾表、动词充当谓语、形容词修饰名词或作表语、副词修饰动词/形容词/全句。
rules: 严禁词性混填：accurate (adj.) / accuracy (n.) / accurately (adv.)；analyse (v.) / analysis (n., 复数 analyses) / analytical (adj.)；vary (v.) / variable (n./adj.) / variation (n.)。
警惕词缀语义陷阱：predictable 表示“可预测的”而非“已被预测的”；successive 表示“连续相继的”而非“成功的（successful）”；priceless/meaningless 语义受语境限定；bi-monthly 有歧义，学术写作应改写为 every two months 或 twice a month。
英美拼写（analyse/analyze, behaviour/behavior, parametrisation/parameterization）在同一篇文稿中必须统一。
examples: Accurate records are essential for checking the analysis.
Attendance increased in three successive years.
The appendix clarifies the coding procedure.
common_errors: 形容词与名词混用：*assess the accurate of measurements（应为 accuracy）。
混淆同根异义派生词：把 successive（连续的）误作 successful（成功的），把stationary（平稳的）误拼为 stationery（文具）。

grammar_instruction.name: 不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 动词后接不定式（to do）还是动名词（doing）取决于动词配价规约；同时注意 warrant, facilitate, advocate, involve, consider, anticipate 等核心学术动词的补足语限制。
rules: 接动名词（doing）或名词、不接不定式的典型动词：consider, involve, advocate, anticipate, recommend, suggest, warrant（warrant further investigation / warrant revising），facilitate（facilitate comparison，严禁写 *facilitate sb to do）。
接不定式（to do）的典型动词：aim, attempt, tend, seek, intend, resolve, enable sb to do, allow sb to do, force sb to do, oblige sb to do。
examples: The report advocates providing clearer information to applicants.
The procedure involves checking every record twice.
A common reporting format can facilitate comparison across studies.
common_errors: 误用不定式：*warrant to conclude / *facilitate researchers to compare / *advocate to provide / *involve to check。

grammar_instruction.name: 状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握从属连词（although, whereas, while, provided that, because, in that）、介词短语（despite, in spite of, due to, prior to, in light of, in the absence of）与连接副词（nevertheless, nonetheless, consequently, conversely）之间的句法转换。
rules: 让步压缩：Although the approach has limitations -> Albeit with limitations / Despite its limitations（严禁写 *despite of）。
条件限定：provided that / as long as + 完整分句 <-> subject to / under + 名词短语。
对照结构：whereas / while 连接两个对称分句（The first model uses monthly data, whereas the second uses daily data）。
examples: The approach is informative, albeit with limitations.
The result applies provided that the assumptions hold.
The estimate remains uncertain despite the larger sample.
common_errors: 混淆介词与连词：*despite the sample is large。
while 表对比时与时间含义发生歧义（在时序/并发场景中表对比优先用 whereas）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 谨慎归因与多因素解释（May Account For / Be Attributable To）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to / stem from [Factor A] rather than [Factor B].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在分析实验误差或异常现象时，客观提出可能成因而不武断定论。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
Measurement error may account for part of the discrepancy.
common_errors: *attributable for / 把可能成因直接写成唯一确定原因。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This study/paper examines [specific problem] and aims to [verb] [measurable objective] within [stated scope].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 开门见山说明研究问题与范围，主语简短，直接用强动词 examines / addresses / investigates。
examples: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
The aim of this paper is to compare annotation rules.
common_errors: 使用冗长空洞的套话开头，或写 *address to a problem。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：不是所有动词都能自由加 -able；predictable 不等于已被预测。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The instrument is portable and can be used in the field.

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 有某种作用的物质或人等
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：anti-depressant / antidepressant 为药物类别词，不由词缀推断疗效。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The laboratory replaced the coolant before the next test.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：accuracy 是名词，accurate 是形容词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team assessed the accuracy of the measurements.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：并非所有 -ee 词都可机械解释为被动接受者。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Each trainee completed a supervised task.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：likelihood 的形容词相关形式是 likely；注意拼写。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study compares experiences in childhood and adulthood.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：clarification / purification / unification 为相应名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The appendix clarifies the coding procedure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：英美拼写及出版社偏好不同；全文保持一致。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The department publicised the symposium on its website.

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 思想、学说、体系，或行为、性质
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：modernist 可为名词或形容词；Marxism 大写。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The seminar examines modernism in literature.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：词义由语境限定；colourless 的美式拼写为 colorless。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Without a clear definition, the label is meaningless.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：autocrat指独裁统治者；democrat可指民主制度支持者。democratic、democratise/democratize属于相关词族。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The course compares democracy and autocracy.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术写作中 abandon an approach 需交代具体实验/校准原因，不等于轻微修改（modify/alter），也不带情感贬义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team abandoned the approach after repeated calibration failures.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：只指确实在前出现的内容。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The above figures describe the sample.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：绝对与相对结果可能不同；单位和基数必须明确。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The absolute difference was reported alongside the relative change.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多词性多义：作形容词指抽象概念，作可数名词指论文摘要（摘要中的指标结论必须与正文实验表严格一致）。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00024 adj.] 抽象的（例：Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.）；[V00025 n.] 摘要（例：The abstract states the study aim and its principal limitation.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：前缀；有些词写作一词，如 antibacterial；拼写以词典/格式要求为准。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Anti-pollution measures may include tighter limits on emissions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：biannual 通常一年两次；biennial 每两年一次；bimonthly 有歧义，应写 every two months 或 twice a month。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A bilingual questionnaire provides the same questions in two languages.
